About us

Our mission and expertise

We bring AI into spectroscopy so R&D and industry can make faster, more accurate, and scalable decisions.

About Us

Fast, Accurate, AI-Powered NMR Spectral Analysis

Rombo AI is an Italian deep-tech startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in Cagliari. We develop advanced Artificial Intelligence solutions for spectral analysis, helping industries overcome one of the most persistent bottlenecks in chemical and material characterization: slow, expert-dependent laboratory analysis.

Our team is composed of PhDs in Machine Learning, Physics, and Mathematics, with deep expertise in software development and Spectroscopy. This unique combination allows us to design AI-driven solutions that are both scientifically rigorous and practically applicable. Meet our leadership: Andrea Zanda, Carmine Mattia, and Silvia Bongiovanni.

Our Vision

To redefine chemical industrial analysis by making the combination of Artificial Intelligence and NMR seamlessly accessible, enabling businesses worldwide to innovate with precision, speed, and AI confidence.

Our Mission

We empower medium and large enterprises – especially in energy, oil & gas, electrical assets and chemicals, including circular chemistry – with fast, precise, and automated molecular characterization and quantification. By combining cutting-edge Low Field NMR spectroscopy with our patented Artificial Intelligence models, we deliver end-to-end automated solutions that reduce manual work, accelerate R&D breakthroughs, and set new standards for efficiency. Rombo AI is also supported by Smart&Start Italia.

Our Values

1. Innovation Without Boundaries
We thrive on bold ideas and unconventional thinking. Our "no rules rule" fosters creativity, experimentation, and breakthrough solutions in spectroscopy and AI.

2. Excellence
We hold ourselves to the highest professional and scientific standards, constantly raising the bar to deliver outstanding results.

3. Intellectual Honesty
We are transparent about what works and what doesn't. We respect data over dogma, ensuring our clients receive truthful, unbiased insights.

4. Precision With Purpose
We are relentless in delivering accurate, reliable, and compliant insights, ensuring our partners can make confident, data-driven decisions.

5. Global Vision, Local Impact
We think and act globally, valuing diverse perspectives and delivering solutions that advance chemical analysis for industries worldwide.

6. Client-Centric Partnership
We build lasting relationships grounded in trust, transparency, and shared goals. Every engagement starts with understanding your challenges and ends with measurable, validated results.
